name: NEWAGE
full_name: NEw generation WIMP search with an Advanced Gaseous tracker
summary: NEWAGE is a directional dark-matter experiment at Kamioka, Japan, using a small gas TPC to search for WIMP nuclear recoils with three-dimensional vector information.
detection_principle: Recoil ionization in fluorine-bearing gas is reconstructed with a micro-pixel readout detector. Track length, direction and electron-background rejection enter a statistical search.

results.summary: A larger dataset and three-dimensional vector analysis provide directional WIMP-search constraints.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
